body:
Approved spec: .adlc/specs/SC-019-v21-wizard-real-offers.md (v2.1, builds on SC-014). Do not edit the specs. Do not call Gemini or any live API in tests. Do not commit secrets, personal data, or the e-bill PDFs. Money is integer LKR. A percent discount is (amount * rate_bps) // 10000. Hard cut-off 17:00 Colombo 18 Oct 2026 (assumption C8).

Engine and data for v2.1 (spec in-scope items 1, 7, 8, 9).
pantry.py: pantry() ignores every bill dated after today.
planner.py: max_stores 1 to 4 (5 or more rejected); the trip cost applies to each store after the first. Store promotions gain type fixed_price {store_id, sku_id, price_lkr, max_qty, days, valid_to}: up to max_qty units at price_lkr, the rest at shelf; percent and fixed-price promotions never stack and each line takes the one that saves more; card offers use the promoted price. Keep CP-SAT, determinism, and tie-breaks.
fixtures/v2/offers.json: replace the fictional NTB and Commercial Bank card offers with the six published in-store supermarket offers listed in the spec (captured 18 Oct 2026), each with source_url, captured_on, headline, terms_source assumption, and assumption values for min_bill_lkr, cap_lkr, and categories. HNB offers stay fictional (source fictional). Add at least two fixed-price promotions, one UHT milk 1 L at Cargills LKR 500 for up to 3.
tests/test_planner.py and tests/test_pantry.py (completed SC-016/SC-017 tests) are updated only where the spec supersedes them: max_stores 3 is now allowed, and real offers carry a source instead of the demo-shape note.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Bills after the planning date are ignored. Verify: python -m pytest tests/test_pantry_cutoff.py::test_bills_after_planning_date_are_ignored -q
2. Fixed-price multi-buy limit holds and the card uses the promoted price. Verify: python -m pytest tests/test_planner_promotions.py::test_fixed_price_multibuy_limit -q
3. Real bank offers cite their source. Verify: python -m pytest tests/test_offers_v21.py::test_bank_offers_cite_their_source -q
4. Up to four stores. Verify: python -m pytest tests/test_planner_promotions.py::test_up_to_four_stores -q
5. Every test passes. Verify: python -m pytest -q
title: v2.1 engine: pantry cut-off, fixed-price promotions, real bank offers, up to four stores
